column1: # Calipic icon small-size structure metrics -- draft v0 stand-in
# openness_*: 0 = gap fully closed (reads as mark colour), 1 = fully open (reads as field colour); max bilinear sample within +/-1 px of the gap centre, scanned along the stroke.
# strand_peak: strongest pixel change the negative-space strand causes, as a fraction of full mark/field contrast. strand_px: nominal strand width in px.
